name: duskhaul-grit
artStyle: Grimdark gritty pixel art: chunky low-resolution sprites drawn on a 16px silhouette grid and rendered crisp at 2x cells, with a 1px hard outline in the darkest palette colour around every silhouette. Dithered two-step shading only, no anti-aliasing, no smooth gradients, no painterly edges. Surfaces are dirty and wet: rusted iron, mud-caked bone, moss-seamed stone, each carrying exactly one small wet-surface specular where torchlight strikes. Everything dead sags and slumps; proportions are heavy-shouldered and hunched, never heroic or cute. Orthographic 3/4 top-down camera at constant distance and constant standing-equivalent scale. Forbidden: clean saturated cartoon colour, glossy plastic finish, anti-aliased curves, lettering, texture noise finer than the pixel grid.
camera: Orthographic 3/4 top-down view, subject centred, constant camera distance and constant standing-equivalent scale across every frame and every asset in the set.
lighting: Single guttering torch key light from the upper left in warm amber, cool dusk ambient from everywhere else, one small wet-surface specular per material where the torchlight strikes. Lights are confined to metal edges, flame, arcane glow and loot glints. No cast shadow, no ground contact shading, no ground plane.
outline: Uniform 1px outline in near-black #0d0b10 on the outer silhouette; internal separation lines only between overlapping body parts, also #0d0b10. Never a light or coloured outline.

plan.temperature: Gameplay colour code, non-negotiable per asset: threat is dried-blood red #c0392b glows and telegraphs; reward is gilt #d9a24b shimmer on shards, relics and chests; extraction and arcane are dusk-violet #5b4bff light; the player and allies carry a gloam-green #8a9a5b rim; hazard telegraphs are torch-amber #e8c547. The world itself stays cold desaturated plum-grey so every coded hue reads at thumbnail size.

focal.primary: the single glowing element of the sprite: eyes, arcane light, flame, or the icon glyph
focal.secondary: the silhouette-defining prop: scythe, banner, crown, bell, ribcage
focal.rest: large unbroken masses of dark plum-grey body, mud and stone

materials.bone: dry porous bone in parchment tones, chipped edges, two value steps, mud in the joints
materials.metal: rusted pitted iron, one thin wet specular along the struck edge, dark red-brown rust bloom
materials.cloth: rotten sodden cloth hanging heavy, ragged hems, two value steps, never a clean fold
materials.stone: wet cracked stone with moss seams, one damp highlight band where torchlight lands
materials.flesh: grey-green cadaver flesh, sunken, matte, darkest at the joints
materials.energy: hard-edged pixel glow in dusk violet or torch amber, a bright core and one dithered fringe step, never a soft bloom
materials.wood: split rain-black timber, straight sparse grain, iron nails
